Raw

Source: R/raw.R
anndata-raw.Rd

Internal R6 class behind adata$raw, following src/anndata/_core/raw.py. A Raw holds X, var and varm and shares its observations with the parent AnnData, so obs_names and n_obs come from the parent.

Arguments

parent

The AnnData the Raw belongs to.

X

The raw data matrix with n_obs rows, or NULL to take X, var and varm from parent.

var

Variable annotation, as for AnnData().

varm

Aligned mapping or named list of arrays with a row per variable.

from_parent

Whether to take X, var and varm from parent.

call

The call reported by conditions.

Details

Without X the Raw is built from the parent's own X, var and varm, which is also what Python does when adata$raw <- other is given an other whose X is NULL.

raw[i, j] subsets with R indices (see anndata-index) and never drops dimensions. The result belongs to a copy of the parent restricted to the observations in i, and keeps varm rows in step with j. raw[i] subsets observations only.

var and X may be assigned, which is what raw$var$col <- v needs, and an assigned value is validated against the other Slots of the Raw. In Python they are read-only properties that are modified in place.
